product_metadata.title: Tumbler Home Sea Glass for Crafts, Decor and Vase Filler. Frosted Beach Glass in Bulk. 25oz Aqua & Mint Seaglass Pieces
features: SEA GLASS DECOR - Add a pop of color to your coastal home, wedding, party or aquarium! Tumbler Home's frosted sea glass can be used to decorate centerpieces, picture frames and votive candles or you can fill your favorite vase, mason jar, glass jug or aquarium to create a 1 of a kind design, You can even pair our seaglass with Tumbler Home's white shells, sand dollars and starfish for a unique nautical design that will wow your guests.

QUALITY & VARIETY - Each of Tumbler Home's real sea glass assortments are custom made by dying, breaking and tumbling recycled glass to produce a rich frosted color craft glass in a variety of shapes. The sea glass pieces in our mixes range in size from .05" to 2" inches. These seaglass pieces will brighten up an beachy wedding, tropical party or coastal Christmas decorations.

ARTS & CRAFTS TIME - Let your imagination run wild! Our bulk sea glass can be used for a wide range of DIY arts & crafts projects to make sea glass jewelry, decorative mirrors, frames, bowls, bottles, ornaments or wind chimes, Arrange these frosted glass rocks as a mosaic on your serving trays, placemats and hot plates for unique sea glass art. From beach chic to rustic & reclaimed our seaglass mixed are perfect for any project.

WIDE SELECTION OF COLORS - Tumbler Home's colored glass pieces are available in a wide variety of colors. We offer custom beach glass mixes in blue, aqua, turquoise, pink, green, jade, mint, teal and white.

PROFESSIONALLY PACKED - We only use recycled glass to ensure minimum impact to aquatic life. All of our genuine sea glass for sale is quality controlled and hand packed in our Florida warehouse to ensure it arrives in the best possible quality at your door.
